## Problem to solve

Describe the defensive, SOC, or purple-team decision that is difficult today.

## Proposed experience

Explain the smallest useful change in terms of what an analyst would see or verify. Screens, sketch links, and synthetic examples are welcome.

## Evidence and ATT&CK context

If applicable, include the ATT&CK technique IDs, expected evidence, and the detection or remediation decision this would improve.

## Safety and scope

Explain how the idea remains useful for authorized, dry-run, and synthetic-lab workflows. Do not request credential theft, exploitation, unauthorized discovery, or instructions that would enable harm.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workaround or adjacent tool behavior that informed the request.
